datasets.label: Horálek · optical
datasets.title: The LMC in visible light
datasets.description: A photograph by Petr Horálek, made with a wide-aperture telephoto lens on a commercial camera, about four hours over three nights on Cerro Pachón, Chile. Its colors are a display choice, not calibrated measurements. Stars, gas and dust are placed from catalogues on the LMC’s measured warped disc, and the model is calibrated to this photograph. The photograph constrains one viewing direction; the depths of individual objects are adopted, not measured.
datasets.summary: A photograph, not telescope data; its colors are a display choice, not measurements. The model is calibrated to it.

facts.label: Light
facts.value: Visible light; colors are a display choice

facts.label: Depth
facts.value: Published disc and warp; adopted thicknesses and object depths

datasets.label: DECam · optical
datasets.title: The LMC in the DECam survey
datasets.description: The same stars, gas and dust, with colors graded to the DECam image from the SMASH survey, not reconstructed from it: no shape, gas or dust comes from that image. 68 of the 354 gas regions lie outside its frame and keep the same colors. The picture shown from far away carries only an overall color change.
datasets.summary: The same model graded to the DECam image, not reconstructed from it. Some gas regions lie outside its frame.

facts.label: Depth
facts.value: Published disc and warp; adopted thicknesses and object depths

datasets.label: VISTA · near infrared
datasets.title: The LMC in near infrared
datasets.description: The same stars, gas and dust, with colors graded to the VISTA near-infrared image from the VMC survey, not reconstructed from it: no shape, gas or dust comes from that image. Glowing gas is faint at these wavelengths, so it is not forced red. The picture shown from far away carries only an overall color change.
datasets.summary: The same model graded to the VISTA image, not reconstructed from it. Gas is faint in this light.

facts.label: Depth
facts.value: Published disc and warp; adopted thicknesses and object depths
